scene: The clanking car glides skyward over glowing rain barrels and cloud tanks.
beats: You trade a pocket mint for dried sourfruit as the car docks, the cabin chime ringing as the doors glide open.
A tinny chime ripples overhead, coaxing sleepy fireflies from the ceiling vent just as the doors open at the terrace.
Tracing the neon line reveals a hidden observatory spur, right as the funicular halts and slides its brass doors wide.
picture: Inside a slanting glass-and-brass cabin, a passenger sits left clutching starfruit chips. The player stands centre in corduroy jacket and beanie, brass telescope slung. Up high, a winding music box gleams on the ceiling beam. On the right, a route map glows. Outside, rooftop rain barrels glow far below.
shown: a passenger holding a bag of starfruit chips on the left
a brass lullaby box mounted beneath the window up high
a glowing constellation map frame mounted on the right wall

variants.scene: Warm lamplight hums inside the trolley as city rooftops drift below your window.
beats: A swap of treats earns you a crunchy bite just as bells ring and the doors glide open.
Delicate notes twinkle above your head, rousing tiny glowing bugs before the car slides open its welcoming doors.
Following the starry lines uncovers a secret skyward track, right before the funicular brakes and smoothly opens its doors.
variants.ride_on: Riding past the station, you roll through velvet night until a friendly tow truck meets you, hauling you onward into bustling Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: The quiet cabin sways gently, carrying you upward into the cool purple twilight.
beats: You trade a pocket candy for tart chips right as the bell rings and doors slide wide.
Sweet metal notes drift from above, waking warm sparks in the grate until the car stops and doors open.
Your finger maps out an unlisted platform, just as the cabin eases into place and slides its doors apart.
variants.ride_on: The car sails beyond the dock into cool shadow, where a cheerful tow truck takes you all the way to Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: You lean on the rail, whistling {tune} as dusk rolls across the skyline.

A silvery melody drifts from the tiny mechanism, stirring resting fireflies as the trolley docks and opens its doors.
Gazing at the connected dots shows a hidden rooftop turn, right as the car gently halts and its doors part.
